name: Large integer sets with no two-other-product divisibility
description: construct() -> nonempty distinct integers in 2..256. For every THREE DISTINCT members a,b,c, require that a does not divide b*c. Maximize cardinality. In particular b and c cannot denote the same member; this convention is part of the finite contract. Only the interval up to 256 is searched. The verifier uses three distinct members, and it does not claim a sharp asymptotic error term or optimal cardinality.

sources.locator: Paul Erdős, On sequences of integers no one of which divides the product of two others and on some related problems (1938). Introduction and section 1 study A-sequences in which no member divides the product of two other members; the sequence of primes is an explicit example.
